character_types: men in black leather and sunglasses
visual_synopsis: This appears to be a COMPILATION of three separate sketches: a mustached doctor in a white coat holding forth behind his desk while a worried husband and wife wait, with cutaways to the clinic corridor and washroom; two men in black leather and sunglasses squatting in a dry field passing something wrapped in cotton between them before driving off and being pulled over by a white Lada militsia car; and a fairy-tale parody in an autumn forest where a woman in a red hood with a basket runs through the trees and is met by men costumed as a white sheep and a grey wolf.
